caveats: Missing optional safety or skill-activation scores are not successes.
No independent performance-threshold or answer-quality grade is inferred.
Timeouts and other runtime failures remain unscored in the planned denominator.
Same-harness Claude comparison does not establish model-only causality versus Devin.
Live backend state, sampling, ordering and concurrent execution may affect results.
Native transcripts exclude hidden reasoning and remain private source evidence; current public artifacts are sanitized projections, not full transcripts.
Partial-run archives are snapshots, not evidence that pending attempts completed.
methodology.completeMeaning: All planned attempts terminal, not all attempts graded or passed
methodology.failedMeaning: Graded failures only; terminal nonpasses = failed + unscored
methodology.grading: Existing numeric case scores and verdicts retained unchanged; no regrading; grading details withheld for privacy_review
methodology.latency: Nearest-rank p50/p95 and max from observed score.latency_ms only
methodology.passRateDenominator: 105 per model; 210 combined, including pending and unscored
methodology.sourceSummaryHashScope: Original private pre-projection model summaries; these hashes do not identify the current public summary bytes.

methodology.answerQuality: Existing deterministic grader does not independently judge answer quality
methodology.auth: Native Anthropic subscription OAuth; isolated credential-only SQLite profile shared for refresh leases
methodology.concurrency: Two model processes; sequential trials within each model
methodology.latency: Observed-score latency only; runtime-failure wall duration recorded separately
methodology.performance: Declared suite latency/byte ceilings are recorded, not pass gates in existing grader
methodology.unscored: Typed runtime failures have no fabricated observation or score; included in planned denominator
